text:
**Tree-cover loss was detected, but the evidence does not establish whether the forest was cleared.** Satellite data show about 0.7 hectares of loss in 2023, or 1.2% of the 58.1-hectare property. The affected area was mapped as forest in 2020.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the affected area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. Another 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in smaller patches that were not counted as an event.

The loss could reflect plantation harvesting or another cause. The evidence does not establish its cause or whether the land use changed.
